title: JavaScript Examples
description: Copy-ready JavaScript snippets and small pages for common tasks: converters, loops, string and array processing, classes, error handling, async timing, and DOM pages that react to the user.

examples.title: Temperature converter
examples.description: Two small functions that convert between Celsius and Fahrenheit, called in a loop and formatted with toFixed.

examples.title: FizzBuzz
examples.description: The classic loop exercise: numbers divisible by 3 print Fizz, by 5 print Buzz, by both print FizzBuzz. Uses the remainder operator and a falsy-string fallback.

examples.title: Slugify a title
examples.description: Turns a heading into a URL-friendly slug by chaining string methods: trim, lower-case, replace symbols (with a small regular expression), split on whitespace and join with hyphens.

examples.title: Shopping cart total
examples.description: Prices stored as integer cents to avoid floating-point errors, line totals printed in a loop, and a subtotal computed with reduce plus a conditional shipping fee.
examples.output:
1 x Keyboard: $49.99
2 x Mouse: $39.98
3 x USB cable: $17.97
Subtotal: $107.94
Shipping: $0.00
Total: $107.94

examples.title: Word frequency counter
examples.description: Counts how often each word appears using an object as a map, then ranks the entries with toSorted and prints the top three.

examples.title: Bank account class
examples.description: A class with private fields, a getter, chainable methods that validate their input by throwing, and a statement built from the transaction history.

examples.title: Safe JSON parsing with a fallback
examples.description: Wraps JSON.parse in try/catch so invalid input (for example a corrupted localStorage entry) falls back to defaults instead of crashing the script.

examples.title: Countdown with async/await
examples.description: A sleep helper built on setTimeout and a promise, used by an async function to count down without blocking the rest of the script.

examples.title: To-do list
examples.description: A form that adds tasks to a list, checkboxes that mark them done through event delegation, and a live summary. Uses preventDefault, createElement and classList.
examples.code: 0 tasks

examples.title: Live character counter
examples.description: A textarea with a maximum length and a counter that updates on every keystroke, turning red when fewer than ten characters remain. The counter is announced to screen readers with aria-live.
examples.code: 100 characters left

examples.title: Dark mode toggle
examples.description: A button that switches the page between light and dark by toggling a class on body, updating its own label and aria-pressed state.
examples.code:
Theme toggle

Click the button to switch between light and dark mode.

examples.title: Render JSON as a table
examples.description: Parses a JSON string (the same text a fetch call would return) and builds table rows with createElement and textContent, so the data is never injected as markup.
